name: agentic-sdlc
description: Consolidated SDLC Factory for coding agents: knowledge foundation, story drafting, requirements -> spec -> plan -> QA, MR/PR creation and watch, knowledge harvester, and HTML report generation.

interface.shortDescription: Consolidated SDLC workflow orchestration for Codex
